name: Albuñuelas (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes, green above, white in the middle and barry wavy of white and blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albuñuelas (a deer on white, a river, a cross and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Albuñuelas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy stripes in the lower third
